description: Invoice repeats the $75 documentation fee as line 9. Line 9 has the same chargeType (doc_fee) and amount as earlier line 8, so the duplicate rule fires before any rate check: potential_discrepancy R1, expected 0, delta $75. Line 8 is still supported R0. R1 lines are never asked about, so the question still covers only lines 4 and 6. At stake $300 + $75 = $375.
